Le suivi du projet avance bien et les mesures restent stables pendant la saisie de ce texte de test qui contient environ deux cents caracteres afin de calculer une mediane et un p95 fiables sur la latence de frappe.

steps.eval: (async()=>{const p=T.vault('01_WORK','__DAILY NOTES SYNTH.md');let f=await T.inv('read_file',{path:p});let m=f.mtimeMs;const text=T.text();const ms=[];for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const t0=performance.now();const r=await T.inv('save_file',{path:p,text:text+'\nsauvegarde '+i+'\n',expectedMtimeMs:m});ms.push(+(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(1));m=r.mtimeMs;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,350))}const r=await T.inv('save_file',{path:p,text:f.text,expectedMtimeMs:m});const s=[...ms].sort((a,b)=>a-b);return JSON.stringify({bytes:text.length, runs:ms, median:s[3], min:s[0], max:s[6]})})()

(()=>{const a=rocksy.sidebar.search.samples;const stt=(k)=>{const s=a.map(x=>x[k]).sort((x,y)=>x-y);const q=p=>+s[Math.min(s.length-1,Math.floor(p*s.length))].toFixed(1);return {median:q(.5),p95:q(.95),max:q(1)}};return JSON.stringify({searches:a.length, keystrokeToPainted:stt('total'), callRoundTrip:stt('call'), backendMs:stt('backend'), filesMax:Math.max(...a.map(x=>x.files))})})()

(async()=>{const tree=await T.wait(()=>rocksy.tree.entries.some(e=>e.path.endsWith('Note externe perf.md')),15000);const t1=Math.round(performance.now()-window.__w0);let found=-1;const t0=performance.now();while(performance.now()-t0<15000){const r=await T.inv('search',{query:'perfzygo'});if(r.total>0){found=Math.round(performance.now()-window.__w0);break}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25))}return JSON.stringify({treeShowsFileAfterMs:t1, searchFindsFileAfterMs:found})})()
